Sarvam 0.24 vs surya 0.38 headline is statistically invalid: sarvam n=54 (48 valid) Wilson 95% CI ~0.151-0.329 (+-0.15), surya n=1227 CI +-0.013 [0.372,0.398]. Claim 'beat 87.39' needs full 1,227-item Sarvam run.

FS-010 spec: add Wilson 95% CI to every per-lang/overall CER (sec 6.7; campaign sec 9.3). Caveat: Wilson is a binomial-proportion interval, applied here to CER (a mean error rate) - methodologically loose; examples inconsistent (sarvam n=3 'CI 0.151-0.329' vs per-item 0.001 n=2 [0.000-0.054]).

McNemar discipline: two-sided exact McNemar on discordant pairs per (engine pair x lang), pass = CER<0.5 per item; pairs n_common<30 excluded; n_common<50 flagged low_conf (D4). Family 55 pairs x 19 langs = 1045 triples; computed 606, skipped 439.

McNemar wins/losses (p<0.05): surya 67W/8L/42T, easyocr 36/15/66, indicphotoocr 33/27/63, tesseract_bilingual/indic/openbharatocr 28/15/80, paddle 27/24/66, rapidocr 15/51/57, anuvaad 12/33/78, doctr 6/77/40; sarvam 0/0/0 (n too small).

Per-lang McNemar partials: surya beats 9 opponents on bn, brx, hi, kok, ks; sd surya 7 / paddle 7; or and pa are tesseract-family/indicphotoocr/surya 5-way ties; sa easyocr 5 / paddle 5 (no outright winner); en doctr 6 partial.
Surya McNemar claims: brx p<0.012, ks p<0.0006, kok p<0.008 (leaderboard) - note leaderboard line 156 says 'surya dominates Devanagari at p<0.008' but mr/or are tesseract wins and sa surya empty.

Scripts with 100% empty for rapidocr+paddle+anuvaad: bn, pa, gu, or, as (+mni, sat all four incl surya); ne rapidocr 54% empty; ks only anuvaad empty. Raw CER 1.000 for these = UNRELIABLE (abstention, not error).

Abstention rule: report coverage + conditional CER separately (sec 6.7); suppress or footnote winner claims for n>=50 cells with high abstention (bn, pa, brx, ks CAUTION); no winner claims for n<50 cells as, mni, sat, ne, gu, doi.
